{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Qwen 8B CWM s456 — full test eval after training completes
# Designed for GPU 3
set -euo pipefail

GPU="${1:-3}"
CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_repo_cwm_8b_s456"
MODEL_NAME="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-8B/"
BATCH_SIZE="${2:-4}"
OUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/qwen3_8b_cwm_s456_eval"

cd /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

# Auto-detect latest checkpoint
FINAL_CKPT=$(ls -d ${CKPT_BASE}/checkpoint-* 2>/dev/null | awk -F'checkpoint-' '{print $NF, $0}' | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)
if [ -z "$FINAL_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No checkpoints found in ${CKPT_BASE}"
    exit 1
fi
STEP=$(basename "$FINAL_CKPT" | sed 's/checkpoint-//')

echo "========================================"
echo "Qwen 8B CWM s456 — Test Eval"
echo "Checkpoint: ${FINAL_CKPT} (step ${STEP})"
echo "GPU: ${GPU}, batch_size: ${BATCH_SIZE}"
echo "Start: $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')"
echo "========================================"

mkdir -p "$OUT_BASE"

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPU python eval_repo_cwm.py \
    --checkpoint_dir "$FINAL_CKPT" \
    --model_name "$MODEL_NAME" \
    --split test \
    --device cuda:0 \
    --max_seq_length 8192 \
    --max_new_tokens 512 \
    --batch_size "$BATCH_SIZE" \
    --output_dir "$OUT_BASE"

echo "========================================"
echo "s456 Eval Complete: $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')"
echo "Checkpoint: step ${STEP}"
echo "Results: ${OUT_BASE}/"
ls -la "${OUT_BASE}/"
echo "========================================"
